rules: Build and quick stay at exactly two validators.
Source stays at exactly ten current-authority validators.
Framework stays at exactly four current framework validators.
Historical/pass validators are explicit full certification only.
Historical evidence remains preserved and non-authoritative.
The root-control generic test path runs cargo test plus the bounded current source profile; historical pass validators remain explicit certification only.
Historical module-size thresholds do not block current-source validation; the legacy architecture size gate remains available through full certification.
